Description: Lack of governed exchange rate between liters of fuel and kWh of unmet critical load
Documented Requirement State: Qualitative intent to minimize fuel and serve load reliably
Impact on Dispatch: High: Drives extreme diesel dispatch under low forecast solar
Required Governance Action: Stakeholder decision on authorized fuel-vs-reliability penalty weight

Description: Absence of numerical maximum allowable unmet critical load ceiling
Current Implementation State: Soft penalty in objective without hard bound
Documented Requirement State: Qualitative goal for zero shortage / high reliability
Impact on Dispatch: Medium: Allows unmet load when solver deems fuel penalty lower
Required Governance Action: Establish governed SLA / maximum unmet load threshold (kWh)

Description: Absence of explicit numerical fuel target or annual fuel consumption cap
Current Implementation State: Minimizes linear fuel cost term in objective
Documented Requirement State: Qualitative requirement to minimize diesel fuel
Impact on Dispatch: Medium: Optimizer has no hard fuel budget constraint
Required Governance Action: Authorize formal numerical fuel consumption target / ceiling

Description: Absence of governed load priority classification and shedding sequence
Current Implementation State: Simplistic deferrable/curtailable load definitions in config
Impact on Dispatch: Low to Medium: All unmet load treated equally at $10000/kWh penalty
Required Governance Action: Define formal multi-tier load priority classes and shedding hierarchy

Description: Absence of dynamic emergency BESS reserve floor above technical min SOC
Current Implementation State: Technical 20% min SOC used as absolute floor
Documented Requirement State: Qualitative goal for emergency protection and energy security
Impact on Dispatch: Medium: Battery can be discharged to 20% under normal dispatch
Required Governance Action: Establish explicit emergency reserve BESS floor (kWh or % SOC)

Description: Lack of stochastic/robust reserve policy for forecast uncertainty
Current Implementation State: Deterministic point forecasts used in horizon optimization
Impact on Dispatch: High: EMS is vulnerable to unmodeled forecast errors
Required Governance Action: Authorize uncertainty margin policy or robust/stochastic formulation

Description: Absence of governed terminal SOC constraint at end of 24h horizon
Documented Requirement State: Qualitative intent for continuous sustainable operation
Impact on Dispatch: Medium: BESS may be depleted at horizon end forcing generator start
Required Governance Action: Specify terminal SOC equality/inequality constraint for MPC horizon

Description: Absence of quantitative renewable energy integration target (%)
Documented Requirement State: Qualitative intent to maximize renewable integration
Impact on Dispatch: Low: Optimizer prefers renewable generation over diesel when available
Required Governance Action: Establish formal renewable fraction target or maximum curtailment cap
